answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock a refundable bond of $100 before accepting jobs, whether it sells lantern designs, lagoon maps, or onyx appraisals. Each bond backs only one active identity and stays locked for 30 days after its last job. An attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must therefore immobilize $100,000; recycling identities cannot reuse that capital during the lock period, making a swarm costly to maintain.
